effective_or_revised: Original Nov 2015; Last Revised Nov 2024 (redline shows 'December 2023November 2024'); Implementation July 2025 (redline shows 'July 20242025'). Library URL is Louisiana Healthcare Connections Medicaid.
sections_in_order: Statement (General Information, Purpose, Scope, Special Note)

Indications (Diagnostic; Chondroplasty; Meniscectomy/Meniscal Repair with Absolute/Relative Contraindications; Meniscal Transplant; Ligament Reconstruction; Articular Cartilage Restoration; Synovectomy; Loose Body Removal; Lateral Release/Patellar Realignment; MUA; Lysis of Adhesions)
criteria_location: General Requirements p.3-4 apply across procedures ('Unless otherwise stated in the subsections below'), then per-procedure Indications pp.4-18. Washington State HTCC determinations pp.18-20 add state-specific limits. Background p.20-21 contains an operative rule (only ONE of MRI or X-ray is required). Grading and activity tables pp.21-23. IMPORTANT: the PDF is 84 pages and holds three bound copies of the guideline (29-page redline with struck/inserted text merged, a 27-page copy lacking the 2024 WA chondral section, and a 28-page copy). The 28-page copy (last) is the clean final; differences exist (e.g., lysis of adhesions in the redline still lists 'Individual has native knee' and 'Manipulation under anesthesia is also performed', which the final removes).
procedures_covered: Articular cartilage reparative and restorative (OAT, OCA, ACI, MACI, microfracture)

logic.top_level: pathways (general requirements all-of, then procedure blocks; many blocks are 'any of Section One..Four')

k_of_n.quote: Unless otherwise stated in the subsections below, non-operative management must include at least TWO or more of the following, unless otherwise specified
When at least two of the following physical examination findings are present or there is at least one of the following physical examination findings and there is a history of mechanical symptoms

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Dedicated Absolute and Relative Contraindication subsections for meniscectomy and meniscal transplant, plus inline 'No K-L grade 3-4' and a universal 'No intra-articular cortisone injections within 4 weeks of surgery' repeated in almost every block. Relative contraindication carries an unless-clause with two sub-conditions.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None for repeat procedures. Only: prior meniscectomy in same compartment bars cartilage restoration unless meniscal transplant; revision not addressed.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Section Four ... o Weight-bearing X-rays ... demonstrate no moderate or severe osteoarthritic changes ... OR o MRI results confirm a frank meniscal tear ... o Failure of at least 6 weeks of non-operative treatment
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An OR between two imaging bullets sits in the middle of an all-of list; whether the failed-therapy and cortisone bullets bind to both sides of the OR depends on indentation.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Two or more or persistent effusion(s)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Garbled: two or more WHAT (effusions? episodes?) or persistent effusion; the noun is missing.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Meniscectomy or repair is considered NOT MEDICALLY NECESSARY in the presence of Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 3 osteoarthritis, Unless: acute onset of locking ...; AND MRI evidence of a bucket-handle or displaced meniscal fragment
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Absolute contraindication says K-L 4 'never'; Section Four says no K-L 3-4; the relative K-L 3 rule has an exception that Section Four does not.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Section One ... Acute ACL tear confirmed by MRI in high demand occupation or competitive athlete (as quantified by Marx activity score ... (any score > 4) and Tegner ... (score > 2)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' between athletics and occupation not stated cleanly; Marx scale in the appendix is 0-16, Tegner 0-10, and a Tegner > 2 includes light-labor jobs.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individual is > 12 weeks post-surgery fracture or resolved infection
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'post-surgery fracture' is not a coherent phrase (post-surgery, fracture, or resolved infection?).

extraction_hazards: PDF contains three copies of the guideline (84 pages): redline with deleted and inserted text concatenated ('December 2023November 2024', 'individualpatient'), plus two clean copies that differ
Repeated 9-item non-operative therapy list under nearly every indication (about 25 repeats) plus footnote citations like '(1,2,3)' glued to criteria
Operative rules hidden in Background (only one of MRI or X-ray required) and in General Requirements
Asterisk notes ('* (see background section)') and TT-TG footnote after the criteria
Mixed bullet glyphs (●, ○, ■, □, o) carry nesting level
Marx and Tegner tables flattened to rows of digits
Washington legislative text sits inside the guideline and reads like criteria
interesting_structures: General requirements that apply to every procedure (cortisone injection washout, optimization, infection, drug dependency)
Numbered 'Section One..Four' any-of pathways inside several blocks
Absolute vs relative contraindication tiers with an unless-clause
Quantified activity scores (Marx, Tegner) used as an eligibility threshold
Case-by-case branches for age <13 and open physis
State overrides (Washington) embedded in the document
Product-level exclusion list for cartilage products
Size-based routing (<2.0 cm2 OAT vs >2.0 cm2 ACI/MACI/OCA)

fit_to_tree.why: Needs shared preconditions applied to every pathway, tiered contraindications with exceptions, quantified scores, case-by-case branches, state overrides and three stacked document versions; the leaves themselves are mostly measurable.
